title: Pope John Paul II: 'we are not alone'

tellings.quote: But back then, when I met the Roman Pope in 1994, I didn't quite understand it.

plain: Pope John Paul II told a visiting leader in 1994 that "we are not alone" in the universe, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, the former president of a Russian republic, who says he met the pope himself. Xenov, who also says aliens took him in 1997, says he did not quite understand the pope's words at the time. He tells it because, read later, it would mean the head of the Catholic Church knew of life beyond Earth.
